Senior IBP Consultant at Westernacher. Paris, France. Apply for this Senior IBP Consultant opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

You will implement business processes and design SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) solutions, taking ownership of functional streams from requirements analysis through configuration, testing, and go-live support. You will work closely with business stakeholders and delivery teams to drive high-quality SAP IBP project outcomes while supporting solution decision-making and continuous process improvement. Your responsibilities: Implement business processes and design SAP IBP solutions. Take ownership of functional streams within SAP projects, from requirement analysis through configuration, testing, and go-live support. Configure SAP IBP, including unit and integration testing, documentation, and validation activities. Translate business requirements into functional specifications and support the development team during build, testing, and deployment. Contribute to workshops with business stakeholders and support solution decision-making. Take responsibility for planning and implementing work packages within SAP IBP projects and ensure high-quality delivery. Your skills and experience: Experience: Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience with SAP IBP. Proficiency: Functional and/or technical proficiency demonstrated in at least 3 full-cycle SAP implementations. Expertise: Strong ability to explain and demonstrate SAP IBP processes and identify process optimisation opportunities. Knowledge: Good cross-module knowledge enabling the design of end-to-end supply chain planning processes. Skills: Solid configuration and solution design capabilities. Mindset: Strong consulting mindset with the ability to propose multiple business process improvement options, including clear articulation of pros and cons. Experience: Exposure to multiple industries with a good understanding of relevant planning and supply chain processes. Certification: SAP IBP certification is an advantage. Exposure: Pre-sales experience, including solution input or proposal support, is an advantage. Commitment: Strong dedication to knowledge sharing, team collaboration, and capability development. Application: Use of AI to optimise delivery, including process analysis, testing support, and reporting, with the ability to explain AI-driven scenarios and assess business value. General requirements: Degree: Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field. Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and French. Languages: Additional languages are an asset. Collaboration: Strong team player able to work effectively in both small and large international teams. Skills: Very good analytical, logical, and problem-solving capabilities. Adaptability: Willingness to gain exposure to different industries and business models. Commitment: Strong focus on high-quality project delivery. Mobility: Willingness to travel as required by project needs Westernacher's promise: Partnership culture with the opportunity for co-ownership in a 100% employee-owned company. A diverse and versatile role with real opportunities to shape your career in an entrepreneurial environment. Inspiring, inclusive, and supportive global working culture. Open communication, trust, and regular feedback within a flat organisational structure. Opportunity to work on complex and innovative projects across multiple industries. Competitive remuneration package Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model. Interested? Then, don't hesitate to apply!
